title: Restore physician-grade product surface without regressing Intent→Evidence→Experience runtime

problem.user_segment: physicians across the six launch specialties
problem.job: use one professional portal that feels editorially curated, visually legible and agent-capable while preserving evidence provenance
problem.observed_failure: The production release preserved backend evidence/runtime capabilities but degraded the user-facing product: raw English source text and internal verification notes are exposed, the For You feed lost editorial/media composition, agent gallery was removed from primary navigation, materials links are not enriched, onboarding/profile/session cues are incomplete, and the shell reads like an admin workspace rather than a physician product.
evidence: Production screenshots 22 Oct 2026: raw English PubMed/FDA content, typography inconsistency, no feed images, non-clickable card surface and weak hierarchy
components/workspace/workspace-frame.tsx explicitly removes the agent catalogue from primary navigation
server/portal/for-you.ts maps raw result.title/result.summary directly into ForYouCard
components/experience/experience-view.tsx renders non-Russian verbatim claims and verificationNote
server/agents/services/material.ts does not fetch/enrich linked pages and falls back to hostname+pathname

hypothesis: If the stable runtime is kept but every physician-facing surface passes through an explicit Experience Quality layer (localization/editorial/media/layout/navigation/onboarding contracts), the portal can recover the previously achieved feed quality and demonstrate agent capabilities without sacrificing provenance, durability or safety.
kill_criteria: raw English clinical prose is shown by default on a Russian physician surface
internal connector/policy/whitelist wording is visible to the physician
a source or provenance item available in the current runtime disappears
an internal agent scenario opens a new browser tab
a short page footer floats mid-screen instead of anchoring to the shell bottom
agent gallery is absent from primary navigation
another specialty receives cardiology clinical fixtures as if they were live specialty evidence
